description: Live Preview for Fluid Checkout Lite: WooCommerce, a sample product, and the checkout page.

steps.data:
<?php
/**
 * Plugin Name: Fluid Checkout Live Preview Cart
 * Description: Adds the sample product to the cart when the WordPress.org preview opens checkout. Exists only inside that preview.
 */

add_action(
	'template_redirect',
	static function () {
		if ( ! function_exists( 'WC' ) || ! WC()->cart ) {
			return;
		}
		if ( ! function_exists( 'is_checkout' ) || ! is_checkout() || is_wc_endpoint_url() ) {
			return;
		}
		if ( ! WC()->cart->is_empty() ) {
			return;
		}
		$product_id = (int) get_option( 'fluid_checkout_preview_product_id' );
		if ( $product_id < 1 ) {
			return;
		}
		WC()->cart->add_to_cart( $product_id );
	},
	1
);

steps.code:
<?php require_once '/wordpress/wp-load.php';
update_option( 'woocommerce_coming_soon', 'no' );
update_option( 'woocommerce_store_pages_only', 'no' );
if ( ! class_exists( 'WC_Product_Simple' ) || ! function_exists( 'wc_get_page_id' ) ) {
	fwrite( STDERR, "WooCommerce is not active.\n" );
	exit( 1 );
}
$product = new WC_Product_Simple();
$product->set_name( 'Sample product' );
$product->set_regular_price( '20' );
$product->set_status( 'publish' );
$product->set_catalog_visibility( 'visible' );
$product->set_stock_status( 'instock' );
update_option( 'fluid_checkout_preview_product_id', (int) $product->save() );
$zone = new WC_Shipping_Zone( 0 );
$instance_id = $zone->add_shipping_method( 'flat_rate' );
update_option(
	'woocommerce_flat_rate_' . $instance_id . '_settings',
	array(
		'title'      => 'Flat rate',
		'cost'       => '5',
		'tax_status' => 'none',
	)
);
update_option( 'woocommerce_bacs_settings', array( 'enabled' => 'yes', 'title' => 'Direct bank transfer' ) );
update_option( 'woocommerce_cod_settings', array( 'enabled' => 'yes', 'title' => 'Cash on delivery' ) );
if ( (int) wc_get_page_id( 'checkout' ) < 1 ) {
	fwrite( STDERR, "WooCommerce did not create the checkout page.\n" );
	exit( 1 );
}
flush_rewrite_rules();
